title: Entry & Patio Door Contracts: Notice of the Three-Day Cooling-Off Right
content:
A door sale made in the customer's home carries the federal three-day cooling-off right printed on the contract. These terms apply to Entry & Patio Door Contracts.

## Terms

1. The cooling-off right applies only to door contracts whose sales channel is in-home. The sales channel is read from the contract record.
2. A door cancellation qualifies for the cooling-off terms only when the customer's written notice of cancellation is given no later than the end of the cooling-off period counted from the contract signing date.
3. Business days are counted starting the day after the contract signing date, skipping Sundays and U.S. federal holidays, so Saturdays count as business days, and notice given on the last counted business day still qualifies.
4. Written notice is the signed Notice of Cancellation form, an email to the contract inbox or a letter, dated the day it is given or postmarked, and is recorded as a cancellation request.
5. A qualifying cancellation carries no fee or charge of any kind, and every payment received is refunded in full, each against its own source payment, within the refund window counted in business days from receipt of the notice.
6. Notice given after the period ends, or on a showroom or virtual consultation contract, is handled under the standard cancellation terms.

The total refunded on a qualifying cancellation is every payment received on the contract net of anything already refunded.

## Timing examples (hypothetical in-home contracts, 3-business-day period, no federal holiday in the span)

| Signed on | Last counted business day | Notice dated | Cooling-off terms |
|---|---|---|---|
| Friday | Tuesday (Saturday 1, Monday 2, Tuesday 3) | Tuesday | Qualifies |
| Friday | Tuesday | Wednesday | Does not qualify: standard cancellation terms |
| Tuesday | Friday (Wednesday 1, Thursday 2, Friday 3) | Thursday | Qualifies |

A letter is dated by its postmark: a letter postmarked on the last counted business day qualifies even if it arrives later.

## Outcome table

| Sales channel | Notice dated within the period | Terms applied |
|---|---|---|
| In-home | Yes | Cooling-off: no fee or charge, every payment refunded in full against its own source payment |
| In-home | No | Standard cancellation terms |
| Showroom or virtual consultation | Either | Standard cancellation terms |

## Hypothetical refund

An in-home customer paid a $1500.00 booking deposit by card and a $500.00 progress payment by check, then gave qualifying notice. Both payments are refunded in full: $1500.00 against the card payment and $500.00 against the check payment, $2000.00 in all, with no fee.
